answer: The cheapest real defence: make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because marble only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. Concretely, onyx is enforced in the ledger: Detection is retrospective: payouts for a flagged cluster are clawed back after the fact. Any delta approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
